title: YouTube and TikTok notifications
description: The bot posts on your server when a followed channel or account uploads a new video or goes live. No API key needed; it doesn’t announce existing videos, only new ones.
resourcesUnavailable: The server’s channels and roles can’t be loaded right now (Discord error) — saving isn’t possible until then. Try again in a minute.

youtube.link: the link to the video / live stream
youtube.cim: the title of the video / live stream

tiktok.link: the link to the video / live stream
tiktok.cim: the video’s description / the stream’s title

defaultsHint: If empty, the bot’s default text is sent: {defaults}
unknownPlaceholder: Unknown placeholder: {list} — it will appear literally.
roleHint: The role must be mentionable by anyone, or the bot needs the “Mention all roles” permission.
liveText: When they’re live (the card updates when the stream ends)
ownTextsText: The message above the card. The ping role is added in front automatically. Placeholders:
searchingYt: The bot is looking up the channel…
searchingTt: The bot is looking up the account…
addText: The bot looks it up and from then on announces new videos and live streams. Texts and switches can be set in the list after adding.
fullYt: You’ve reached the limit of {max} channels — you can add a new one only after deleting an existing one.
fullTt: You’ve reached the limit of {max} accounts — you can add a new one only after deleting an existing one.
deletedChannel: deleted channel — choose a new one
unfollowText: The bot will no longer announce their new videos and live streams. You can add it again later.
deletedText: {name} — the bot won’t announce it any more.
emptyYt: You’re not following any YouTube channel yet
emptyTt: You’re not following any TikTok account yet
emptyEdit: Add one above — from then on the bot announces new videos and live streams.
emptyRead: The server’s managers can add new ones.
footnote: The bot checks for new videos every few minutes, and for live streams more often. If something goes wrong (e.g. it can’t post in the channel), the reason is shown on the card.
addTextStream: The bot looks it up and posts whenever it goes live — the card closes itself when the stream ends.
emptyStream: You don't follow any {platform} channels yet
liveOnly: The {platform} alert is for live streams: a card goes out when it starts and closes when it ends.
